Eleni Christofi ( Greek : Ελένη Χριστοφή ; born 9 August 1998) is a Greek tennis player. Career [ edit ] Christofi has a career-high doubles ranking by the WTA of 192 achieved on 21 October 2024. She has won 16 doubles titles on the ITF Women's World Tennis Tour . On the junior tour, Christofi has a career-high junior ranking of 61, achieved January 2016. Playing for Greece in the Billie Jean King Cup , Christofi has a win–loss record of 5–1 as of July 2024.
